Author: CheesyChiz
Name: Stock Manager
Punchline: Balances Island Sanctuary stock with imported Visland routes.
Description: Choose Island resources and stock levels, then let Stock Manager select imported Visland routes. Supports route editing and supervised generation, sortable resources, farming priorities with scheduled reviews, flight, underwater and guided cave navigation, an Island route map, mount override, stuck recovery, Lifestream, surplus export, run statistics, and /sm commands.
Changelog: Added a guided flight out of the initial cave before starting an outdoor route. If the corridor cannot be traversed, Stock Manager now falls back to Isle Return instead of repeatedly navigating into the cave wall.

Author: CheesyChiz
Name: Positional Cue
Description: Positional HUD and target ring with sound cues. Optional experimental Wrath ST/AoE combo-button forecast with current adjusted cast time and per-job hotbar bindings. Reborn and RSR supply direction-only positional hints. No movement or action execution. Settings: /pcue.
Punchline: Positional hints and an optional Wrath spell forecast.
Changelog: Experimental draggable ST/AoE forecast with Wrath threshold, current cast time and per-job bindings. Removed character movement functionality. Live game validation pending.

Author: CheesyChiz
Name: Emote Shelf
Description: Browse Penumbra emote mods, choose variants, and pin favorites to an icon panel. Supports ground-sit and standing-idle pose slots. Experimental pair launch and optional nearby alignment require Lightless Sync with your partner. Open with /es or /eshelf. Solo playback requires only Penumbra.
Punchline: One-click bookmarks for Penumbra emote mods.
Changelog: Shift+icon or Pair now sends an animation proposal to your linked partner. The movable notification offers local emote/role options, Accept and start, or Decline; a second Shift-click is no longer needed. A unique alternative emote is suggested; same-emote roles require checking the options, as mod roles are not standardized. Identical command/slot/options combinations are blocked. Decline/cancel leaves the connection intact. Each launch has a unique nonce and requires explicit acceptance. Both players need 0.3.3.0. Build, 22 relay tests and live HTTPS proposal/decline/accept/shared-start tests passed; in-game notification and playback still need validation. Music and exact sit/idle phase limitations remain.
